housing.summary: Numbeo reports an average one-bedroom city-centre rent of USD 3,356.75 per month: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Boston Massachusetts Housing Court says a security deposit may be no more than one month's rent: https://www.mass.gov/info-details/learn-about-paying-a-security-deposit Zillow's Boston rental portal: https://www.zillow.com/boston-ma/rentals/

banking.summary: Bank of America requires eligible non-U.S. professionals to bring proof of foreign and U.S. addresses, two forms of ID, and a tax identification number: https://info.bankofamerica.com/en/international/professional-bank-account Chase says non-residents may need government-issued photo ID, proof of U.S. address, and possibly an opening deposit: https://www.chase.com/personal/banking/education/basics/us-bank-account-for-non-residents
required_docs: Proof of foreign or permanent residence address
Two forms of identification, including an accepted photo ID
Possible opening deposit, depending on bank and account

schools.summary: The Boston international-schools directory lists IB, British, French, and American curricula: https://www.international-schools-database.com/in/boston Nord Anglia's official Boston page confirms the National Curriculum for England and IB at British International School of Boston: https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/our-schools/americas/usa/boston

legal_admin.summary: USCIS says noncitizens covered by the rule must report each change of address within 10 days; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt. Reporting can be completed through a USCIS online account or by paper Form AR-11: https://www.uscis.gov/addresschange
legal_admin.registration_step: If subject to the USCIS alien-address rule, report each change of address within 10 days through the USCIS online account or Form AR-11; exceptions include A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors.

tax_finance.summary: The IRS says foreign individuals should apply for an SSN on Form SS-5 if eligible, or for an ITIN on Form W-7 if they cannot get an SSN; Form W-7 requires identity and foreign-status documentation and generally a federal tax return: https://www.irs.gov/tin/taxpayer-identification-numbers-tin
tax_finance.tax_id_name: Social Security Number (SSN) if eligible; otherwise Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN)

transport.summary: The MBTA Monthly LinkPass costs USD 90 and covers unlimited subway, local bus, and Silver Line travel through the last day of the month: https://www.mbta.com/fares Massachusetts RMV permits test-free conversion only for licenses from countries with an established arrangement; otherwise a resident must meet identification requirements and take the learner's-permit exam and road test: https://www.mass.gov/how-to/transfer-your-drivers-license-from-a-foreign-country Massachusetts residents can submit the Health Connector eligibility application to be assessed for MassHealth or other coverage and enroll if eligible: https://www.mahealthconnector.org/start
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Test-free conversion is available only for valid licenses from countries with an established RMV arrangement; otherwise a Massachusetts resident must apply, meet identification requirements, and pass the learner's-permit exam and road test.
transport.healthcare_registration: Submit the Massachusetts Health Connector eligibility application with household information and any requested verification; the application assesses eligibility for MassHealth and other coverage and allows enrollment when eligible.
